title: Wireframe states: one screen, four situations
desc: Every screen that loads data has four faces: the list itself, loading, nothing yet, and an error. Design all four, not just the first.

annotations.title: Status chip
annotations.text: Colour and word, never colour alone.

annotations.title: Skeleton
annotations.text: Grey bars in the shape of the real rows, so nothing jumps when data arrives.

annotations.title: Spinner and text
annotations.text: Shown after about a second. The skeleton alone is enough before that.

blocks.detail: When you order, it shows up here so you can track it.

annotations.title: Empty icon
annotations.text: Dashed, quiet. Nothing is wrong; there is just nothing yet.

annotations.title: One action
annotations.text: Empty states offer the next useful step, not a dead end.

blocks.detail: We could not load your orders. Check your connection and try again.

annotations.title: Error icon
annotations.text: Rose, solid, with an exclamation mark. Plain words, no codes.

annotations.title: Retry first
annotations.text: Retry is primary. A second route, such as support, is secondary.
